title: 2024 Starbucks Green Stainless Steel 16oz Tumbler - No Lid, No Straw (Used)
descriptionText:
See picture - scratch on front under logo. No Lid, No straw.

This 2024 Starbucks Green Stainless Steel 16oz Tumbler is the perfect addition to any Starbucks collection. With its sleek design and Dark Green color, it's sure to catch the eye of any coffee and tea lover. The tumbler features the iconic Siren Starbucks Logo and has a 16 oz. size, making it perfect for your daily coffee or tea fix.

This original Starbucks item was created in 2024 and manufactured in China.
